Senior Backend Engineer — CloudScale Inc

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our growing platform team.
You will design and build distributed systems that power our SaaS product.

Requirements:
- 4+ years of backend engineering experience
- Strong proficiency in Python and Go
- Experience with Kubernetes and Docker for container orchestration
- Solid understanding of REST APIs and microservices architecture
- Experience with PostgreSQL and Redis
- Familiarity with AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda)
- CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions, Jenkins)
- Strong knowledge of machine learning pipelines is a plus
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Nice to have:
- Experience with Apache Kafka or message queues
- Knowledge of Terraform for infrastructure as code
- Contributions to open-source projects

We value engineers who write clean, well-tested code and care deeply about reliability.
Kubernetes experience is especially valued — our entire platform runs on Kubernetes.
Knowledge of Docker and container best practices is required.
